Implementation Plan

Interpreted clarification context
- No `Q<ID>` questions were issued in clarification.
- Parsed answer: `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` means planning can proceed with current issue scope.

Conflict check (issue vs current branch)
- The issue requires tests for `check-vs-gate` split, repair-step invocation, `MAX_POST_CODEX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS`, and scope-guard behaviors, but those identifiers/flows are not present yet in current `.github/workflows/implement.yml` and test suite.
- The issue also requires blocker-linked reissue behavior in the poller; current `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` has implementation-failed reissue logic, but no explicit blocker-link metadata/reissue-deferral hooks matching that requirement.
- This is consistent with listed dependencies (`repair-prompt-and-validator-split`, `fixup-orchestrator-integration`, `implement-repair-step`, `reissue-dependency-gate`) likely not fully landed on this branch yet. Plan below assumes those dependency changes are present when implementation begins.

Implementation plan

1) Files likely to change
- `tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py`
- `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`
- Potentially `.github/workflows/ci.yml` only if new test files are created (avoid by extending existing test files).

2) Functions/modules to implement (test-side)
- Extend implement-workflow test harness in `tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py`:
  - Reuse representative pattern: `test_diagnose_prompt_contract_round_trip_and_fixup_metadata` + `_run_diagnose_step`.
  - Add/extend GH mock capture (likely `_install_mock_gh`) so created issue labels and reissue metadata can be asserted.
  - Add additive tests for:
    - check-vs-gate split semantics,
    - repair invocation conditions,
    - retry-cap behavior for `MAX_POST_CODEX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS`,
    - scope-guard allow-list enforcement,
    - scope-guard violation rollback,
    - repair success continuing to commit path,
    - repair failure falling through to existing #829 diagnose/fix-up lane.
- Extend poller tests in `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`:
  - Reuse representative harness: `_run_poller` + existing `validation-fixing`/reissue tests.
  - Add additive tests for:
    - fix-up labels on created post-Codex fix-up issues,
    - state-file metadata injection for blocker linkage,
    - reissue deferral while blockers remain open,
    - unblocking then reissue continuation,
    - reissue message selection by failure class.

3) Data structures affected
- Test mock GH state payloads (`created_issues`, issue labels/comments, issue bodies).
- Orchestrator state assertions (`issue_number_map`, `pending_issue_defs`, wave issue status, plus new blocker-link metadata fields introduced by dependency PRs).
- Implement diagnose/result contract assertions (existing `status/diagnosis/fix_issues/harness_fixes`, plus any new repair-specific fields if introduced by dependencies).

4) API/interface changes
- No production external API change expected.
- Test harness interface changes only (optional params/recording fields in helpers like `_run_diagnose_step` and `_run_poller` fixtures) to assert new behavior deterministically.
- Env-var behavior assertions for `MAX_POST_CODEX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS` (default and override behavior).

5) Risks and edge cases
- Dependency drift risk: tests will fail noisily if required repair/reissue code paths are absent or renamed.
- Fragile string-matching risk for workflow step names; prefer behavior assertions via harness execution where possible.
- Regression risk to existing #829 fallback path; keep prior tests untouched and add only additive scenarios.
- Poller state-transition flakiness risk; keep deterministic mocked store/state and avoid wall-clock-dependent assertions.

6) Testing considerations
- Preserve and run all existing post-Codex regression tests in `tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py`.
- Run full poller unit file to ensure no regression in unrelated orchestrator flows:
  - `python3 tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`
- Run implement recovery unit file:
  - `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py`
- Acceptance gate: new tests cover both success and fail/fall-through branches, and existing #829 tests remain passing.

Execution checklist (mapped to issue scope)

- [ ] Add implement tests for repair-success continuation to commit path.
- [ ] Add implement tests for repair-failure fall-through to #829 diagnose/fix-up path.
- [ ] Add poller tests for fix-up labels on created post-Codex fix-up issues.
- [ ] Add poller tests for state-file blocker-link metadata injection.
- [ ] Add poller tests for reissue deferral while blockers are open.
- [ ] Add poller tests for unblocking and reissue continuation.
- [ ] Add poller tests for failure-class-based reissue message selection.
- [ ] Re-run existing #829 tests and confirm no regressions.
